_comment: How oh-my-herdr launches each agent type. Profiles reference these by name via "agent".
Override or add entries under "agents" in config.json (same shape).
launch = "herdr-kind": `herdr agent start <name> --kind <kind> --pane <pane> -- <args>` (herdr runs its canonical binary).
launch = "command":    runs <command> <args> in the pane with HERDR_AGENT=<detect_as>, waits until herdr detects the agent, then names it.
Use this for forks/wrappers whose executable herdr doesn't know (e.g. senpi, a pi fork).
launch = "subagent":   no pane: a host subagent of the lead. "host" is "claudecode" (default) or "opencode";
the profile's "model" and "subagent_type" pick it; its final reply is saved as result.md.
Optional status-report metadata: "reports": ["herdr", "hc"] lists the backends the agent can report status on;
"min_version": {"hc": "2026.11.21"} the oldest version that reports on that backend; "version_cmd" prints its version.
senpi before 2026.11.21 never reports to hc (OSC 7501), so on the hc backend its workers would time out at startup.
